$comment: PlutusShield Cardano Preview deployment. Public settings only; keys live in .keys/ (gitignored). See README.md.

oracle.$comment: policy 'native-sig:oracle' = a native script signed by .keys/oracle.sk (Preview test oracle). For a real oracle set policyId to its 56-hex policy and keep the feed allowlist in sync.

saleGuard.$comment: Sale circuit-breaker. Cover starts waitingPeriodMinutes after the Buy can last land, and the Buy must reference a healthy-peg reading from every feed, each no older than maxPriceAgeMinutes. Preview uses a 60 min wait so drills stay quick; the SDK default (and mainnet target) is 24h / 120 min.
